description: A semiabstract, blue, pitched roof with two burgundy chimneys spans the length of the composition. A gray dormer with a brown window juts out from the roof. Pink shapes cover the roof of the structure. A small strip of gray-blue sky is visible above the roof.
title: Untitled (Roof with Snow Study Sketch)
